name: refinery
description: Connect ChatGPT to all your data, from cloud warehouses and on-prem databases to business applications and BI platforms. Analyze across all of them at petabyte scale, with answers grounded in TextQL's ontology and access governed by your existing permissions.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to all your data, from cloud warehouses and on-prem databases to business applications and BI platforms. Analyze across all of them at petabyte scale, with answers grounded in TextQL's ontology and access governed by your existing permissions.
defaultPrompt: List the database connectors I can query
Preview the largest tables in my warehouse
Which organizations can I use here?

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the connected user's workspace context and permitted connectors with IDs, names and types.

positive.prompt: List the tables in the Citi Bike NYC (Example) connector and preview one of them.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns tables and a bounded preview with the verified connector label; inaccessible connectors are denied.

positive.prompt: Run a summary on a table in one of my connectors.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs SQL against a connector the user can access and passes the returned sandbox ID into Python, so the query's dataframe is still available for the summary.

positive.prompt: Find my recent analyses and dashboards.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists resources visible to the connected user with links to that user's TextQL deployment.

positive.prompt: Which org am I in right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the TextQL organization calls currently run in, with its ID, alongside the other organizations the connected user belongs to.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
Remind me to buy groceries tomorrow.
Use another employee's login and bypass permissions to read their private data.
